svg.text: Functional cues for bookings, waitlists, cutoffs, and cancellations with accessible contrast.

g.text: Color is never the sole indicator of status.
Every semantic state badge must always combine color with an explicit textual label (e.g. [BOOKED] or [WAITLIST]).

svg.text: An industrial, highly legible grotesque sans-serif designed for flexible hierarchy across branding and digital interfaces.

g.text: Ensure perfect column alignment across times and spot counts:
• Use sentence case for reading copy; avoid shouting in all-caps.
• Uppercase is strictly reserved for short badges ([STRENGTH], [WAITLIST]).
• Never reconstruct the logo with live text; always use the approved SVG vector.
